explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states or directly specialises this result. It gives one specific coefficient of (X - C x₀)^(p^t·m) in characteristic p. The library's proof needs several Mathlib lemmas: `sub_pow_char_pow`, `expand_X`/`expand_C`, `coeff_expand_mul` and `coeff_X_add_C_pow`, followed by binomial-coefficient arithmetic. The closest single lemma is `Polynomial.coeff_X_add_C_pow`, which covers general (X + C r)^n. In characteristic p, though, it gives this coefficient as x₀^(p^t)·C(p^t·m, p^t·(m-1)), up to sign. Rewriting that as m in k needs a Lucas-type congruence, which is substantive work, not routine glue. I also grepped for other `coeff_X_sub_C_pow`/`coeff_X_add_C_pow` variants and found nothing closer.
